GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG601 (21 Dec 45) ESS/FI
(SCAPIN-478)
21 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Protection of Allied property.
1. On or before 3 January 1946, you will submit to this Headquarters a complete list of all those who have acted as administrators of Allied Property under “The Administration Law of Enemy Properties, No. 99, 22 Dec. 41,” and the “Ordinance Relative to the Enforcement of the Administration Law of the Enemy Properties No. 1179, 22 Dec. 41.”
This list will include the following information concerning each administrator:
a. Name, present addresses, both business and private, and present position or occupation.
b. Any changes in address, position and occupation since 7 December 1941.
c. Areas and periods with which the Administrator was charged with the administration of Allied property.
2. The Imperial Japanese Government will require that all persons mentioned in Paragraph I. will report any subsequent changes of address and keep the Government apprised of their whereabouts at all times.
3. An acknowledgment of the receipt of this momorandum is directed.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.Allen
Colonel,A.G.D.
Asst Adjutant General
